bio: The legendary Café de Paris boasts a prime location in the heart of town, just above the Grande Plage. Diners choose dishes from an intelligently updated brasserie repertoire, inspired by the local terroir and peppered with nods to the Iberian peninsula. Think supreme of free-range poultry browned in a sauté pan, piperade spiced up with chorizo and confit grenaille potatoes. Pleasant terrace....
